_note: Inputs for cfo.ai (Ari). measured=true means read from neatlogs traces in evidence/. All else is an assumption with a reason.

cost_per_run_model.source: neatlogs: evidence/neatlogs_analytics_v1.json, totalCostUsd 0.10491 over 4 v1 firstrun.run traces. Model cost at Sonnet 5.5 list price, not billed.

cost_per_run_compute.source: Assumption. One t3.medium VM per run, billed for the measured duration only. Reason: a small VM runs the container. Formula 0.0416 x 128.449 / 3600.

recovery_multiplier.source: Assumption. v1 has no recovery, so 1.0. Replace with v2 measured.

Free.reason: Assumption. 1 quickstart weekly is about 4 runs a month.

Team.reason: Assumption. 10 quickstarts nightly is 300 runs in a 30-day month.

Scale.reason: Assumption. 100 quickstarts nightly is 3,000 runs in a 30-day month.

payment_fee.source: Assumption. Stripe standard card rate, https://stripe.com/pricing. Not re-checked today.

Free.source: Assumption. Free users drift away fast.

Scale.source: Assumption. Larger accounts switch tools less.

fixed_costs_per_month.source: Assumption. Domain about $1, static hosting on a free tier, $24 reserve for email and monitoring. neatlogs and Entire CLI use free tiers, no public price confirmed, so $0.

starting_cash.source: Assumption. Founder savings put into the company.
